device_entry.name: 数字X射线脉冲处理器（DXP）/多道分析系统
device_entry.name_en: Digital X-ray Processor (DXP) / Multichannel Analyzer System
device_entry.description: 这是一类用于X射线探测器读出的数字脉冲处理与多道能谱分析电子学设备，可连接一个或多个通道，对探测器输出脉冲进行处理、计数并生成能谱数据。它常用于X射线荧光、能量色散谱以及同步辐射实验中的能谱采集与映射测量。
device_entry.description_en: This is a digital pulse-processing and multichannel spectroscopy electronics system for X-ray detectors. It can serve one or more detector channels, process detector pulses, count events, and produce energy spectra. It is commonly used for X-ray fluorescence, energy-dispersive spectroscopy, and synchrotron-based spectral acquisition and mapping measurements.

schema.description: 为测量准备并配置设备采集状态。
